posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Final: Guardians 3, Rays 2 Petey Halpin hit one of those postseason homers you'll remember for a while, Gavin Williams racked up nine more strikeouts and Cade Smith picked up a four-out save. Cleveland is two wins away from a World Series berth.
posts.jp: 試合結果：ガーディアンズ3-2レイズ。ピーティー・ハルピンが長く記憶に残るポストシーズン弾を放ち、ゲイビン・ウィリアムズは9奪三振、ケイド・スミスは4アウトセーブ。クリーブランドはワールドシリーズ進出まであと2勝。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Petey Halpin just launched a baseball and chucked his bat basically as high into the air. 2-run shot. 3-2 Cleveland.
posts.jp: ピーティー・ハルピンが打った瞬間、バットをほぼ真上に放り投げた。2ランで3-2、クリーブランドが勝ち越し。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Proud Merrill College alum shouting out a dogged reporter here www.thebanner.com/politics-pow...
posts.jp: メリル・カレッジ卒業生として誇らしい。粘り強い記者を紹介したい。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies have fired hitting coach Kevin Long, sources confirm James T. Salisbury report. They've fired infield coach Bobby Dickerson as part of a larger defensive overhaul in org. Other changes too: www.nytimes.com/athletic/766...

reply_texts.text: Honestly I have no idea how Kevin kept the job as long as he did. Good riddance.
reply_texts.author: tomfoldsfive.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Nothing says overhaul like keeping your underachieving GM and uninterested manager.🤷‍♂️
reply_texts.author: collsmike.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Not surprised to hear the Phillies are shaking things up - their offense has been a bit of a struggle lately. Hope they find someone who can get their bats clicking again!
reply_texts.author: churchandbaseball.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズがヒッティングコーチのケビン・ロングを解任。ジェームズ・T・ソールズベリーの報道を関係者が確認。内野守備コーチのボビー・ディッカーソンも、球団全体の守備改革の一環として解任。他にも変更あり。

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: You and your 42,000 closest friends can watch tonight’s NLCS Game 4 on a really, really big TV. www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: 今夜のリーグ優勝決定シリーズ第4戦は、4万2000人の仲間と超大型ビジョンで観戦できる。

posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: The Brewers are one win away from their first-ever NL pennant. They’re one win away from their first pennant of any kind since 1982.
posts.jp: ブルワーズが球団史上初のナ・リーグ優勝まであと1勝。1982年以来となるリーグ優勝まで、あと1勝だ。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: From @jaysonst.bsky.social: The Phillies requested to interview to Chase Utley and Raul Ibañez for manager job. They said thanks but no thanks. More here: www.nytimes.com/athletic/769...

reply_texts.text: Chase Utley and Raúl Ibáñez declining the Phillies interview is a two-way-market signal: candidates can screen the manager job too. Ask who controls roster decisions, what authority the manager has, and how success is judged.
reply_texts.author: goodworkdept.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Who wants Dombroski over the top of them and a core of 5 immovable high priced aging stubborn underachievers below?
reply_texts.author: justfrank13.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I don't know if he's interested in the job, but I always thought Jimmy Rollins was managerial material. Smart, a natural leader - back in the day, you'd always see him at Charlie's side.
reply_texts.author: beer-radar.bsky.social

posts.jp: @jaysonst.bsky.socialより：フィリーズは監督候補としてチェイス・アトリーとラウル・イバニェスに面談を打診したが、2人とも辞退。
